items.name: Morlock Landscape and Design
items.angle: Family-owned landscape site with strong experience proof but generic CTA hierarchy, service sprawl, and a long form that can be tightened.

items.name: Mikes Landscaping Service
items.angle: Outdoor-living site with useful service proof but repetitive place headings and a quote path that needs clearer buyer segmentation.

items.name: PN Dog Grooming
items.angle: Small pet salon with warm copy but weak appointment path, thin service packaging, and little owner/experience proof above the fold.

items.name: Sol Rejuvenation Therapeutic Massage
items.angle: GoDaddy-style massage site with repeated welcome copy, hidden service structure, and booking/trust signals that can be brought forward.

items.name: Sudzy Puppy
items.angle: Established grooming salon with services and local proof, but the homepage can make booking, pricing paths, and walk-in options easier to scan.

items.name: Awaken Massages & Skin Care
items.angle: Wellness site with strong service depth but wordy opening copy and multiple booking choices that can be clarified into a simple first-visit flow.

items.name: R&L Landscaping
items.angle: Local family landscaping site with tenure and testimonial proof but dated hierarchy, buried quote CTA, and service sections that need sharper scannability.

items.name: Wiggle Butts Mobile Dog Grooming
items.angle: Mobile grooming site has memorable brand and availability news, but the first screen can better explain service areas, size limits, and booking steps.

items.name: Naperville House Cleaning Service
items.angle: Independent Weebly-style cleaning site with service breadth but dated hero, weak trust proof, and a quote path that can be made easier to scan.

items.name: Perfect Manners Dog Training
items.angle: Behavior-focused dog training site with strong mission language but dated slide-style structure and no crisp problem-to-consultation path above the fold.
